name: Bosch EDC15C6

sources: own reference stock/tuned reads (not committed): maps diff-derived and structure-checked - see docs/MAP-LIBRARY.md
clean-room checksum derivation on own reads - see docs/BOSCH-CHECKSUM.md
ISO 14230-4 (KWP2000 over K-line) public family facts

notes: Older common-rail/CDI diesels. Diagnostics over K-line (ISO 14230-4 KWP2000) with a 5-baud or fast init handled by the driver. tx_id holds the K-line ECU address; its value 0x01 is an UNSOURCED placeholder (no public source names the EDC15C6 K-line address, and a bench ECU did not answer an init at 0x01), so confirm the address for your unit before relying on it. flash_size is the 1 MiB read the EDC15C6 checksum and the bootstrap preset use (own reads); the calibration region is a family placeholder and must be confirmed per software variant before any write.

maps.name: injection quantity limiter (smoke limiter, vs boost pressure)
maps.notes: CONFIDENCE: HIGH. DIFF-DERIVED (reference stock/tuned pair raised the cells at >=1600 hPa) + in-image header at 0x16412 (16 rpm 500..4200 x 16 boost pressure 700..2200 hPa, ids 0xC694/0xC646). Cells decode at the EDC 0.01 mg/stroke LSB to 23.6..86.5 mg/stroke, rising with boost - a boost-pressure-based smoke limiter. Also changed by the reference tunes of SW 1037351637 (identical address) and SW 1037351736/351737 (same header, 0x12 bytes later). Layout: Bosch EDC15 (C167, little-endian) inline header [input-id u16][n u16][Y axis][input-id u16][m u16][X axis][data n*m]; the id word names the input quantity (0xC694 = engine speed in every map here). Byte offsets into the 1 MiB read of SW 1037351686 (0281010826); this read holds the calibration four times (copies at +0xC000, +0x18000 and +0xE0000 - the reference tunes changed all four), so apply the same edit to every copy. Confirm per software variant before any write.

maps.name: boost pressure target
maps.notes: CONFIDENCE: MEDIUM-HIGH. In-image header at 0x15580 (12 rpm 800..4200 x 12 injection quantity 2.5..80 mg/stroke at 0.01 mg/LSB, ids 0xC694/0xD1F2); stock decodes 1100..1780 hPa absolute, rising with load and falling at the rpm limit - a boost setpoint. Not changed by this read's own tune. The same header (same input ids, same offset) sits at the identical address in SW 1037351637 (reference stock/tuned pair), where a tune changed it. There the tune raised the mid/high-load setpoint (to 2200 hPa). maps.name: driver's wish (pedal map)
maps.notes: CONFIDENCE: MEDIUM (structure only, not diff-confirmed). In-image header at 0x16F88 (8 rpm 0..5000 x 8 accelerator pedal 1.2..100 % at 0.01 %/LSB, ids 0xC694/0xC8CA); cells decode at 0.01 mg/stroke to 0..80 mg/stroke, 0 at closed pedal and rising with pedal at every rpm - the driver's-wish shape. maps.name: start of injection, main (role inferred)
maps.notes: CONFIDENCE: HIGH on location/shape, MEDIUM on role, scaling left RAW. DIFF-DERIVED (reference tune changed the >=30 mg columns at 1000..4000 rpm) + in-image header at 0x121C6 (12 rpm 0..4200 x 12 injection quantity 0..100 mg/stroke, ids 0xC694/0xD084). Signed cells go slightly negative at minimal load and rise with quantity - the shape of a main-injection start (advance) map; tunes advance it to burn the added fuel. The crank-angle LSB is not confirmed for this software, so cells are RAW signed counts. maps.name: injector energizing time 1 of 6 (set A, role inferred)
maps.notes: CONFIDENCE: HIGH on location/shape, MEDIUM on role, scaling left RAW. DIFF-DERIVED (the reference tune changed all six 16x20 tables) + in-image header at 0x12928 (16 rail pressure 119..1350 bar at 0.1 bar/LSB x 20 injection quantity 0..100 mg/stroke, ids 0xCA00/0xD092). Cells fall with rail pressure and rise with quantity (0 at 0 mg) - the injection-quantity-to-energizing-time conversion; tunes extend it so the added quantity is actually delivered. Unit is most likely microseconds but is not confirmed (RAW). Set A/B = the two quantity inputs (ids 0xD092/0xD094).
